items.title: Jon Hendricks — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: It took me three years to say hello to Ella Fitzgerald. She kept saying, “It’s about time. I was wondering when you . . . .”

ctx.x: I was too shy. That’s like asking Duke Ellington, can I sing with his band? I was terrified. I’m a very shy person. I really still am very shy. It took me three years to say hello to Ella Fitzgerald. She kept saying, “It’s about time. I was wondering when you . . . .” I’m always very shy about things like that.
I would never have known that. Your music is tremendously outgoing.
